comments.author: @artsyomni
comments.text: 14:08 Speaking for myself as an artist, this proposition is not attractive to me. I create art because I value the process. Every brush stroke or vector path or compositional decision is intentional, and is laden with the specific values that I have about aesthetics. AI isn’t going to be able to replace my brain and make the actual decisions that I would make. It’s going to generate something that is an imitation that superficially resembles the end products that I have made, but it doesn’t afford the possibility of novel decisions that I’ve yet to make based on new information that I’ve more recently assimilated into the library of observations that I’ve made that excite me.
